description: This file contains Polymer framework's core JavaScript code for web component registration, lifecycle management, property handling, and module registration, embedded within an HTML script tag.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Core base class providing lifecycle callbacks, property management, behavior handling, and feature extension for Polymer elements.

classes.name: Polymer.RenderStatus
classes.description: Manages the rendering lifecycle, including readiness callbacks and after-next-render queue.

classes.name: Polymer.ImportStatus
classes.description: Alias for RenderStatus, indicating import loading status.

classes.name: DomModule
classes.description: Represents a <dom-module> element used for defining reusable modules in Polymer.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Removes the 'unresolved' attribute from document.body to signal component readiness.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Determines Polymer configuration based on URL parameters and feature support.

methods.name: Polymer
methods.description: Function for registering a new Polymer element with lifecycle and behavior management.

methods.name: desugar
methods.description: Processes a prototype to prepare it for Polymer registration, handling inheritance.

methods.name: _registrate
methods.description: Registers a component prototype in telemetry and logs registration.

methods.name: whenReady
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called when Polymer is ready.

methods.name: _makeReady
methods.description: Marks Polymer as ready and executes queued callbacks.

methods.name: afterNextRender
methods.description: Schedules a function to run after the next render cycle for a given element.

methods.name: __flushAfterNextRender
methods.description: Executes all functions scheduled for after the next render.

methods.name: createdCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback for element creation, initializes features.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback for when element is attached to DOM.

methods.name: detachedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback for when element is detached from DOM.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: Handles attribute changes and triggers corresponding behavior.
